ArrayRankIndicator.Definition: A comma in an array type declaration that indicates an additional dimension of a multidimensional array.

NullableTypeMarker.Definition: Punctuation that indicates that a value type can also represent null.

NullConditionalGuard.Definition: One of two pieces that make up the null-conditional operator.

PointerTypeIndicator.Definition: The {c:code}*{/c} tells the compiler that the following identifier will store a pointer to the preceeding type instead of the value of the type itself.

ArgumentSeparator.Definition: Separates multiple arguments passed to a method or constructor.

ArrayInitializerElementSeparator.Definition: Separates elements within an array initializer expression.

ArrayLengthSeparator.Definition: Separates the length values of multiple array dimensions.

AttributeArgumentSeparator.Definition: Separates elements within an attribute argument list.

BaseTypeSeparator.Definition: Separates a type from its base class or implemented interfaces.

ComplexElementSeparator.Definition: Separates the key and value within a key-value element such as {c:color-green code}Dictionary{/c} or {c:color-green code}KeyValuePair{/c}.

DeconstructionVariableSeparator.Definition: Separates variables within a deconstruction expression.

EnumMemberSeparator.Definition: Separates individual members within an enum.

InterpolationFormatSeparator.Definition: Separates the interpolated value on the left from the specified format on the right.

MemberPatternSeparator.Definition: Separates the member being inspected from the subpattern applied to that member.

OrderByClauseSeparator.Definition: Separates elements within an {c:color-blue keyword}orderby{/c} clause.

ParameterSeparator.Definition: Separates parameters in a method, constructor, or lambda declaration.

PatternElementSeparator.Definition: Separates elements in a pattern matching clause.

PropertyInitializationSeparator.Definition: Separates a property name from its assigned value during initialization.

QualifiedNameSeparator.Definition: Separates parts of a fully qualified namespace or type name.

SwitchArmSeparator.Definition: Separates a pattern or condition from the result in a switch expression.

TupleElementSeparator.Definition: Separates individual values within a tuple.

TypeArgumentSeparator.Definition: Separates multiple type arguments supplied to a generic type or method.

TypeParameterConstraintClauseSeparator.Definition: Separates a generic type parameter from its constraints.

VariableDeclaratorSeparator.Definition: Separates multiple variables declared in a single statement.

CaseLabelTerminator.Definition: Punctuation that marks the end of a case label in a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement.

CasePatternLabelTerminator.Definition: Punctuation that marks the end of a case pattern label in a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement.

DefaultLabelTerminator.Definition: Punctuation that marks the end of the {c:color-purple keyword}default{/c} case label in a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement.

ParameterLabelTerminator.Definition: Punctuation that marks the end of a parameter label in a named argument.

StatementTerminator.Definition: Marks the end of a statement.
